To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) HIF 1α is expressed in primary and recurrent EC, (2) HIF 3α is expressed in recurrent but not primary EC, (3) HIF 2α is expressed in both primary and recurrent EC and (4) the alternative NF-κB pathway is activated in recurrent EC and is HIF 1 independent.
hypoxia activates both canonical (RelA) and alternative (p100/p52) NF kB pathways, and that both pathways are required for EC cell survival.
hypoxia activates both classical and alternative NF kB pathways in EC cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how hypoxia promotes EC cell survival.
understanding the mechanisms of tumor progression and resistance to therapy in EC, which will lead to novel therapeutic approaches for this disease.
the mechanisms involved in the hypoxia induced survival of EC cells, which could help to develop new strategies to improve radiotherapy efficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the activation of alternative NF kB under hypoxia enhances EC cell survival in a HIF1a independent manner.
the activation of both classical NF kB (RelA) and alternative NF kB (p52) pathways are required for hypoxic cell survival of EC.

HIF 1α is an important mediator of the hypoxic response in endometrial carcinomas, and that the alternative NF-κB pathway is a HIF-1α independent pathway, which contributes to the survival of endometrial carcinoma cells under hypoxia.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hypoxia induces the activation of both classical and alternative pathways of NF kB in endometrial cancer cells.
HIF 1A controls the classical NF-kB pathway and the alternative NF-kB pathway in endometrial carcinoma cells under hypoxia.
the activation of alternative NFkB pathway is HIF1a independent, and that it contributes to the survival of endometrial carcinoma cells under hypoxia.
The main takeaway from our work is that
HIF 1α is a good prognostic marker in EC.
HIF 1A, the main transcription factor activated under hypoxia controls the activation of classical NF kB pathway and survival under low oxygen conditions through RelA (P65) nuclear accumulation.
the alternative NF kB is a HIF 2a independent pathway that is required for hypoxic cell survival of EC cells.
